title: A universe of research. A clearer way to search.
book_title: How Search Decides What You See
author: Aaron Tay

lines.text: A universe of research. One search box. And the paper your researcher needed... never appeared.
Behind every result, a pipeline decides what gets found, ranked, and shown.
Understanding it helps you ask better questions.
Meet How Search Decides What You See. Aaron Tay's free online textbook, written for librarians.
No prior information retrieval knowledge or mathematics required.
Explore Boolean search, B M twenty five, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, and agentic search.
See how the pieces fit together.
Build clearer search lessons. Investigate missing papers. Ask sharper vendor questions.
For evidence synthesis, learn to look beyond a convincing answer.
Try interactive labs, an evaluation kit, and a vendor questionnaire.
Take the teaching notes into your next workshop.
Start with Read This First: a forty five minute guided route.
Read free. Understand the search behind the answer.
